rules.description: Child must attend a government-funded school
rules.reason_if_failed: Free school meals are only available for children at government-funded schools. Contact your school directly if they offer their own support.

rules.description: Parent/guardian must receive a qualifying benefit OR child receives benefit directly
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be receiving a qualifying benefit to apply for free school meals. Check the full list on GOV.UK.

rules.description: If on Universal Credit (applied after 1 April 2018), household income must be under £7,400/year
rules.reason_if_failed: Your Universal Credit household income is above the £7,400 annual threshold

rules.description: If on Child Tax Credit, must not have Working Tax Credit and income under £16,190
rules.reason_if_failed: Your annual gross income exceeds £16,190 or you are also receiving Working Tax Credit

edge_cases.description: Children in reception, year 1, or year 2 receive free school meals automatically
edge_cases.action: Auto-approve for infant free school meals. Encourage registration if on qualifying benefits to unlock Pupil Premium funding for school.

edge_cases.description: Families with no recourse to public funds may still be eligible under local authority discretion
edge_cases.action: Route to local authority case worker for manual assessment. Child may still qualify under local policy.

edge_cases.description: Child receives qualifying benefit directly (not through parent/guardian)
edge_cases.action: Verify child's benefit status directly with DWP. May require additional safeguarding checks.

edge_cases.description: Child is a care leaver or under local authority care
edge_cases.action: Fast-track approval. Coordinate with local authority children's services for ongoing support.
